content.task_ref: Finalize main entry point, configuration, and ASDF system for Common Lisp Orchestrator SDK
content.summary: Completed finalization of the Common Lisp Orchestrator SDK main entry point, configuration system, and ASDF system definition. All implemented modules from rounds 1-7 are now properly integrated and the SDK is ready for use.

sections_implemented: Main entry point with CLI argument parsing
Orchestrator lifecycle management (create, start, stop, restart)
ASDF system definition with proper module ordering
deviations: gRPC integration is stubbed with error handling to allow mock mode operation - actual gRPC implementation requires cl-grpc library integration
log4cl integration is conditional (#+log4cl) to allow operation without it
JSON configuration format is noted as TODO - only Lisp format fully implemented

content.testing_notes:
Test Engineer should verify:
1. ASDF system loads without errors: (ql:quickload :sw4rm-orchestrator)
2. Command-line argument parsing handles all flags correctly
3. Configuration loading from file, environment, and CLI works properly
4. Configuration precedence is correct (CLI > env > file > defaults)
5. Graceful shutdown properly closes all resources (gRPC, WAL, checkpoints)
6. Checkpoint thread starts and stops correctly
7. REPL helpers work as expected (start-orchestrator, stop-orchestrator, etc.)
8. Build script creates working standalone executable
9. All modules integrate correctly without circular dependencies
10. Error handling gracefully degrades when optional dependencies unavailable
content.documentation_notes:
Technical Editor should document:
1. Complete configuration reference with all available keys
2. Command-line usage examples for common scenarios
3. REPL development workflow examples
4. Build and deployment instructions
5. Integration guide for connecting Python sw4rm leaves
6. Troubleshooting guide for common issues
7. Performance tuning recommendations (checkpoint intervals, WAL settings)
8. Security considerations for production deployment
